title: Single benchtop syringe-like pump with tubing and vertical panel
objects_and_counts: One benchtop device resembling a syringe pump is centered near the lower middle of the image; the device has a rectangular base with a display window and a cluster of navigation/control buttons to the right of the window.

One single enclosed syringe (transparent cylindrical reservoir) is mounted on the top carriage area of the device and is aligned along two parallel guide rods; the syringe appears intact and is not visibly broken or disconnected from the mounting.
One flexible tube or cable exits the syringe outlet at the right and forms a single continuous wavy/curled length leading to a freestanding vertical rectangular panel at the far right.
One vertical rectangular freestanding panel is visible at the far right edge of the image and is contacted by or terminates the wavy tube/cable.
Four round control elements (three small circular buttons and one four-way circular navigation pad) are visible on the device's front face to the right of the display window.
Two cylindrical feet or pads are visible under the front edge of the device, supporting it above the surface.
spatial_relations: The benchtop device occupies the lower central area of the frame; the syringe mounted on top is oriented left-to-right, with its tip pointing toward the right side of the image.

Two parallel metallic guide rods run along the top of the device, supporting the syringe and two small rectangular clamping blocks that sit on the rods; the clamping blocks are positioned left of the syringe and between the syringe and the device front respectively.

The flexible tube exits the syringe at the rightmost end, curves in a single continuous wave pattern across empty space, and connects to or meets the vertical rectangular panel at the far right edge of the image.

The display window is on the front face of the device, slightly left of center on that front panel, with the circular navigation pad immediately to its right and three smaller round buttons arranged to the right of the pad.
The device rests on a flat horizontal surface that occupies the bottom of the image; the vertical panel stands upright on the same surface at the right edge.
colours_and_materials: The device body is primarily pale blue and light grey with metallic silver highlights on the guide rods and clamp blocks.
The syringe reservoir is transparent (clear) with a faint bluish tint and metallic end fittings at its right tip.
The flexible tube is light blue or grey and appears smooth; the vertical panel is a pale off-white or light grey with a slightly textured appearance.
The background is a gradient of pale lavender to light grey, and the flat surface under the device is a darker grey-purple tone.
